entries.title: Nobel Prize: Neutrinos from Far, Far Away
entries.summary: Author(s): Michael Schirber Neutrino astronomy and the effort to build a cubic-kilometer-sized detector at the South Pole are recognized by the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics. [Physics 19, 138] Published Tue Oct 06, 2026

entries.title: Nobel winner Halzen says years of October 'misery' finally over
entries.summary: Physicist Francis Halzen has an impressively long list of academic accolades—but every October, as the Nobel Prize rolled around, his failure to bag the biggest award of them all left him "miserable," he admits.

entries.title: X-ray technique reveals how quantum materials respond to laser pulses in real time
entries.summary: Creating a quantum device often begins by intentionally damaging a crystal. Scientists fire an ultrafast laser pulse into a material, knocking atoms out of place and leaving behind tiny imperfections called vacancies. Far from being flaws, these vacancies can behave as…
